notes: Andrew's "chair with legrest" (2026-10-26), the recliner option: living-room g. Flags: none (one package 37 x 34 ¾ x 32 ½", 124 lb 16 oz; an armchair, not a sofa, F-22). A recliner rocker with a 360° swivel: a lever raises the footrest, the backrest reclines under your weight, three positions; two parts that click together. Hakebo dark gray, near the sofa's Gunnared dark gray. Its page gives no reclined depth, so g keeps 10" behind its back off the walkway and a swivel circle clear of the table. Frame of solid pine, plywood and fiberboard, polyurethane foam, polyester wadding; vacuum and wipe clean. No reviews yet (0). Not stocked at IKEA Long Island, NY; order online for delivery (2026-10-26).
